title: Nourishing Savory Japanese Speck Takikomi Gohan
description: A traditional Japanese dish from the Shikoku region, featuring speck and cure in a Buddhist-temple-friendly takikomi gohan recipe, this meal is a cultured and adventurous take on a classic.
instructions: Rinse the Japanese short grain rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and cook the diced speck until crispy.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms to the pan and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown.
In a small bowl, whisk together the sake, mirin, and cure, then add the mixture to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the soaked and drained rice to the pan, stirring to combine with the speck and mushroom mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a rice cooker or a large saucepan with a heavy bottom, adding 2 cups of water.
Bring the water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Once the rice is cooked, stir in the thinly sliced scallions and serve hot.
